# Upstream source migrations

MatOpt uses these read-only source references:

| Upstream | Revision | License | Local reference |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [ZCode](https://github.com/zai-org/ZCode) | `29628c9acdb81b703bbd4080c207a0e7ce5e276e` (v3.14.3) | Apache-2.0 | `/Users/eric/projects/ZCode` |
| [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/ericyerongjun/deepseek-harness) | `639ed015397290b3745d163aafe02ffee4aa3f84` | MIT | `/Users/eric/projects/deepseek-harness` |
| [Anthropic Agent Skills](https://github.com/anthropics/skills) | `41bbe19d1a1a7eaab5e7bb9050a417e5c6cffc8f` | Apache-2.0; `docx`, `pdf`, `pptx`, `xlsx` source-available | `skills/anthropic/` (verbatim; [UPSTREAM.md](../skills/anthropic/UPSTREAM.md), refresh with `scripts/sync-anthropic-skills.sh`) |

The active frontend is copied from ZCode under `frontend/src/zcode`, with its
full stylesheet and Material Icon Theme assets. MatOpt binds the native rendering
components and workspace subtrees to its HTTP/SSE APIs. The consolidated
[source manifest](../docs/reference/zcode-frontend-manifest.json) distinguishes
verbatim files, added provenance banners, explicit whole-file adaptations,
maintained shell subtrees, and original MatOpt adapters. It records immutable
Git blob IDs and SHA-256 hashes; it never treats an adaptation as a verbatim copy.

The earlier DSH frontend primitives, token sheets, portable ZCode skin and their
regeneration scripts were removed during the native frontend replacement.
The historical recovery document records the earlier checkpoint; current UI
acceptance and verification belong to
[ZCODE-ADE-MIGRATION.md](../docs/ZCODE-ADE-MIGRATION.md).

## Source integrity check

```sh
bash scripts/vendor_check.sh
python3 scripts/vendor_zcode_frontend.py --check --source-repo /path/to/ZCode
python3 -m unittest discover -s scripts/tests -p test_vendor_zcode_frontend.py
```

The offline check reconstructs the original bytes of exact copies, banner-only
copies and the stylesheet's two scan-path changes. Reviewed local hashes guard
adaptations. The optional source-repo check reads pinned Git blobs, including
original sources for adaptations. It does not fetch, regenerate files, or modify
the reference checkout. See the [provenance guide](../docs/reference/zcode-frontend-provenance.md)
for reviewing intentional changes and updating their manifest entries.

## Maintained backend adaptations

| MatOpt path | Pinned source and boundary |
| --- | --- |
| `backend/app/agent/session/{derive,repair,stream,validate,events}.py` | DSH `packages/core/session/src/` and `packages/llm/llm/src/assistant-stream.ts`; SQLite transactions replace JSONL storage. See `backend/app/agent/session/UPSTREAM.md`. |
| `backend/app/agent/session/telemetry.py` | DSH `packages/llm/token-meter/src/{turn-usage,estimate}.ts`; MatOpt adds trajectory projections and configured pricing. |
| `backend/app/agent/scheduler.py` | ZCode `apps/zcode-cli/packages/core/src/tool/scheduler.ts`; MatOpt adds read/write barriers and graph validation. |
| `backend/app/agent/tools/read_state.py` | DSH file-observation policy and ZCode `tool/read-file-state*.ts`; MatOpt adds workspace containment, hashes and staged publication. |

These are behavioral adaptations with source headers and regression coverage,
not generated byte copies; the frontend integrity gate does not assert Python
equivalence. Licenses and upstream attribution are retained in
[THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](../THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md) and [NOTICE](../NOTICE).
